criteria.title: Приёмка в браузере на стенде
criteria.how: steps 1, 3, 5 and 6 (given to RELEASE-VALIDATOR) repeated; step 1 opened by the legend button «Основная сессия» (criterion 1 names it as an equal way; the click on the character itself is covered by MC-02, not by this browser run); steps 2, 4, 7, 8 by the records: docs/uat/REQ-047-RUN.md, docs/uat/REQ-046-047-048-049-RUN.md, BA-ANALYST PASS. Stand: an own Pixel Office server started with `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 0 --dir <outside the project>/stand-…` and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR set to the same folder; events written only through the real `src/pixel-office/hook.sh` (26 events: main session sample-1 with an owner request, 10 role runs, B launched by A, two ends, Stop) and one orchestrator record through `src/pixel-office/note.js`; the owner journal, its copies and the ports 4780, 4782, 4790 were not used. Browser: Google Chrome headless, a new profile per page, driven over the debugging protocol with real mouse and key events; Chrome and the stand were stopped by their process ids. Results: <outside the project>/uat/res/po1…po5.json, shots in <outside the project>/uat/res/shots/.
criteria.evidence: Step 1 — see criterion 1. Step 3: card A1 → «события в журнале» — card closed, mark «Задача: Проверка безопасности номер sample-a», «3 из 3», the last row of the task (index 5) expanded and in focus. Step 5: «открыть историю запроса» of the panel item sample-a — window open; Escape — window closed, focus on that button, no card. Step 6: the handoff to «Ревью кода» → «кому» — card «Ревью кода», «номер запуска sample-b»; Escape — focus on «кому».
